messages:
sasha: Heads-up — noticed a spike in console dashboard latency around view eviction windows. Spiking from ~60ms to ~500-1200ms for some tenants. Putting notes here.

jamie: Link to traces?

sasha: https://internal-traces/trace/abcd — flame shows authz check + eviction loop stacked. Fast-path hits cached view OK; slow-path does eviction -> rebuild -> authz which serializes.

priya: Is eviction happening before authz or after? we had that debate in the last RFC.

kevin: Today eviction runs in the query layer after materialization and before final projection, so we re-evaluate perms on fresh data. That gives correctness but costs an extra authz RPC on misses.

jamie: Are we making authz RPCs per-panel? or aggregated? thought we aggregated by view key.

kevin: Aggregated at panel-level, but eviction causes re-read which breaks the aggregation window. If eviction triggers mid-request we re-run perms.

sasha: TL;DR: eviction->rebuild->authz retries are the tail. Proposing: decouple eviction decision from authz check — pick eviction candidate, materialize, prefetch perms in parallel, then apply projection. That avoids serialization.

priya: That sounds async. Main tradeoff: possible brief window where materialized data is available but perms are stale. Need to handle rollback if perms fail.

kevin: We can treat it as optimistic prefetch: run authz in parallel, timeout quickly (200ms), if authz not back then serve degraded view (masked), and kick off async retry. That keeps tail small.

jamie: Degraded view? Product ok with masked panels? need product sign-off. Also need a policy for sensitive panels.

sasha: Agree. Plan: add panel metadata flag `sensitive: true|false`. If true, block on authz synchronously (existing path). If false, do parallel prefetch and degrade. Default false.

priya: Where to store `sensitive`? model repo? console manifest? suggests put in view descriptor in schema so rollout uses infra-as-code.

kevin: Implementation steps: 1) marker in view descriptors, 2) query runtime prefetch hook + 200ms timeout, 3) eviction path switch to 'prefetch-and-apply', 4) metrics + SLO for masked rate.

jamie: Needs telemetry: measure `authz_block_time`, `masked_panel_rate` and `eviction_serialization_count`.

sasha: I added a quick PoC in my branch, logs: `kubectl logs -l app=console -c query --since=1h | grep evict | tail -n 50` shows per-tenant spikes.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for sasha/prefetch-eviction -> canary=10% in prod-west

priya: For rollout, propose 3-stage: canary (non-sensitive tenants), widen to all non-sensitive, then opt-in sensitive by customer flag.

kevin: Also add a feature flag `console.eviction.prefetch=true` and `console.eviction.timeout_ms=200`.

jamie: devex note: update docs and SDK so customers can mark panels sensitive in view manifests. Also add migration script to default to false.

sasha: I'll open RFC follow-up PR with design + metrics + rollplan. Filing follow-up tickets: storage TTL tuning, authz cache TTL, and masking UX.

priya: ack. @jamie can you route to product for sensitivity matrix? also check legal for masked-data exposure.

jamie: Will ping product. :thumbsup:
